messages:
michelle: Noticed SAST flagged header-logging patterns after yesterday's RBAC rename + KMS rotation. Found an Authorization header in staging logs. Opening thread to triage.

dave: Paste a scrubbed log line and timestamp so we can scope exposure.

michelle: Scrubbed: `[2026-05-15T04:12:08Z] staging-proxy GET /_health 200 - headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer [REDACTED-TRUNC]' }` Happened during canary reload.

hannah: Context: infra renamed svc/dast-runner -> svc/dast-scan at 2026-05-14T23:40Z and rotated staging KMS at 2026-05-14T22:30Z. Likely token provider error + fallback logging.

audit-bot: CI-SCAN: run-1422 reported 3 new SAST alerts in infra/dast/*. Link: https://ci.example/runs/1422

oncall: Immediate containment: (1) revoke staging scanner tokens, (2) disable auth in staging scanner config, (3) snapshot current logs/evidence and upload to secure bucket before any redaction, (4) add redaction middleware to proxy to mask Authorization headers.

dave: I'll revoke tokens and push the unauthenticated staging config. Also grepping logs for `Authorization: Bearer` across retention window now.

michelle: I'll open a hotfix PR to remove header dumps and add a test asserting no Bearer in logs. Patch will set `req.headers['authorization'] = '[REDACTED]'` before any logging.

hannah: For compliance: produce mapping of old->new principals and bundle evidence. Plan: query logs for `svc/dast-*` from 2026-05-14T21:00Z..2026-05-15T05:00Z, create CSV (ts,original,canonical,resource,action,log_id), tar/gzip and compute HMAC. Upload to s3://redwood-sec/incidents/INC-2026-081/.

oncall: Open INC-2026-081 and attach timeline + evidence. Keep this thread updated. Schedule 60-min postmortem tomorrow.

dave: Grep found three hits in staging only (container ids: dast-runner-11, dast-runner-12). No prod hits. Evidence archived and uploaded: s3://redwood-sec/incidents/INC-2026-081/evidence-3658881234.tar.gz. HMAC attached.

michelle: PR merged to redact headers and CI re-run shows SAST clean on hotfix branch. Added CI pre-scan hook to fail if auth.enabled==true in staging unless secretRef resolves.

hannah: Mapping CSV and README uploaded to incident bucket with explanation of transform rules for the rename.

oncall: Thanks team. Follow-ups: LOG-301 (pipeline mask), CI-1200 (pre-scan secret check), SAST-777 (rule hardening). Closing thread unless new findings surface. :white_check_mark:
